## Smoother scrolling in "Edit playlist"
- On phones the edit list fills the screen as a plain page, so nothing is blurred or bent behind it on every scrolled frame
- Rows are lighter for the phone to draw, only the song you are dragging gets its own layer
- Scrolling long playlists stays fluid in every theme, Liquid Glass included

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
